title: TopologySemanticSelectorValue
description: One explicitly typed scalar value used by topology semantic selector predicates. The schema keeps generated SDKs stable; topology-service validates that the populated value slot matches kind.

kind.description: Typed scalar slot used by this value.

stringValue.description: String, enum, identifier, or display-name predicate value, for example cisco, Access, Dist1, or root.

numberValue.description: Numeric predicate value, for example VLAN id, metric threshold, score, or percentage.
